terms.name: Customer Complaint
terms.description: The timestamp when a customer complaint was first recorded or submitted. This captures the initial point of customer interaction regarding an issue, used to track when complaints originate in the system.

terms.name: Attempt Sequence
terms.description: The sequence number of the attempt to process a payment, indicating whether it was the first or second try.

terms.name: Payment Bill ID
terms.description: A unique identifier for each bill transaction, formatted as a string with a prefix and sequential number.

terms.name: Payment Method
terms.description: The method of payment used for the transaction, such as cash, card, or UPI.

terms.name: Payment Note
terms.description: Additional textual information or comments associated with the transaction, if any.

terms.name: Till Status
terms.description: The outcome of the payment processing at the till, such as approved, declined, or failed.

terms.name: Transaction Amount In INR
terms.description: The total amount of the transaction in Indian Rupees (INR).

terms.name: Transaction Reference Number
terms.description: A unique transaction reference number generated by the payment terminal to identify a specific transaction.

terms.name: Transaction Timestamp
terms.description: The exact timestamp when the payment transaction was initiated or recorded.

terms.name: Bill Reference
terms.description: A reference code linking the transaction to a specific invoice or bill issued by a business.

terms.name: Initiated Date And Time
terms.description: The timestamp when the transaction was first initiated or started by the system.

terms.name: Status Updated Date And Time
terms.description: The timestamp when the status of the transaction was last updated or changed.

terms.name: Total Amount In Indian Rupees
terms.description: The total amount of money involved in the transaction, expressed in Indian Rupees.

terms.name: Transaction Reference Number (store014.payments.psp_upi_report)
terms.description: A unique identifier assigned to each transaction, typically used to track and reference a specific payment or invoice.

terms.name: Transaction Status
terms.description: The current state of the transaction, indicating whether it was successful, failed, or returned to the sender.

terms.name: Refund
terms.description: A unique identifier assigned to each refund request, formatted as RF followed by a number.

terms.name: Gross Revenue
terms.description: The total amount of revenue generated from all transactions before any deductions, such as refunds or payment processing fees.

terms.name: Merchant Discount Rate Fee
terms.description: The merchant discount rate (MDR) fee paid by the merchant to the payment gateway or processor, in Indian Rupees.

terms.name: Net Revenue
terms.description: The final amount of revenue available to the merchant after deducting refunds and merchant discount rates, in Indian Rupees.

terms.name: Refunds
terms.description: The total amount of money refunded to customers for cancelled or disputed transactions, in Indian Rupees.

terms.name: Settlement
terms.description: The date when the transaction settlement is processed and funds are transferred to the merchant.

terms.name: UPI Credits
terms.description: The total number of UPI transactions that were successfully credited to the merchant's account during the period.

terms.name: Product
terms.description: A unique identifier for a specific product, such as a type and size of item like rice or lentils.

terms.name: Sale
terms.description: The date when a sales transaction occurred.

terms.name: Daily Forecast Units
terms.description: The estimated number of units of a product that are expected to be sold each day based on historical sales data.

terms.name: Forecast Date
terms.description: The specific date when the inventory or sales data was recorded, used to timestamp the forecast entry.

terms.name: Forecast Method
terms.description: The specific method used to generate the sales forecast, such as averaging daily sales over a 28-day period.

terms.name: Forecast Variability
terms.description: A measure of the variability or uncertainty in the daily sales forecast, indicating how much demand might deviate from the average.

terms.name: On Hand Inventory
terms.description: The current number of units of a product that are physically available in inventory at the time of the record.

terms.name: On Order Inventory
terms.description: The number of units of a product that have been ordered but not yet received or delivered.

terms.name: Order Up To Level
terms.description: The maximum inventory level to which an order should be raised when replenishing stock.

terms.name: Ordered Units
terms.description: The total number of units of a product that have been ordered for delivery in the past or current period.

terms.name: Product SKU
terms.description: A unique identifier for a product, such as a type of grain or food item, based on its category and size.

terms.name: Reorder Point
terms.description: The inventory level at which a new order should be placed to avoid stockouts.

terms.name: Delivery
terms.description: The timestamp indicating when a delivery was made. This captures the exact moment of delivery, useful for tracking timing and scheduling patterns in fresh deliveries.

terms.name: Delivery Packaging
terms.description: The number of crates used to transport the delivered goods. This reflects packaging volume and logistics usage.

terms.name: Delivery Quantity
terms.description: The total number of individual units of a product delivered. This reflects the quantity at the item level (e.g., individual bottles or slices).

terms.name: Product (store014.store.fresh_deliveries)
terms.description: The unique product identifier for a specific item, such as MILK-TONED-500ML or BREAD-WHITE-400G. This identifies the type and variant of the product delivered.

terms.name: Product Expiry
terms.description: The date by which a product must be consumed or used before it expires. This is critical for freshness and inventory management.

terms.name: Route
terms.description: The route identifier assigned to a delivery, such as R-07 or R-12. This identifies the path or distribution route used for the delivery.

terms.name: Goods Receipt Line
terms.description: The sequence number of the line item in the goods receipt, indicating its position within the receipt. Used to identify specific items in a multi-line receipt.

terms.name: Goods Receipt Note
terms.description: A unique identifier for each Goods Receipt Note, formatted as a string with a prefix and date code. This is the primary key of the goods receipt record.

terms.name: Pallet
terms.description: A unique identifier for each physical unit or item in a shipment, typically used to track individual packages or products in a supply chain.

terms.name: Product SKU (store014.store.products)
terms.description: A unique identifier for a product variant, such as its type and size, used to distinguish different offerings in the inventory.

terms.name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipments)
terms.description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as SHP followed by a sequence number.

terms.name: Inventory Date
terms.description: The date representing the specific day for which inventory data is recorded. This captures the day-end inventory status for a given SKU on a specific day, forming the temporal anchor of the record.

terms.name: Inventory On Hand At Close
terms.description: The number of units of a product available in inventory at the end of a specific day. This reflects the final count of stock after daily operations.

terms.name: Product SKU (store014.store.inventory_book)
terms.description: A unique identifier for a product, such as a type of food item or ingredient, formatted with a code that indicates its category and size. This identifies the specific product in inventory.

terms.name: Bill
terms.description: A unique identifier for each bill, formatted as a string with a prefix and sequential number. This identifies the specific bill to which the line belongs.

terms.name: Bill Line
terms.description: The sequence number of the item line within a single bill, indicating its position in the list of items. Used to order items on a receipt or invoice.

terms.name: Product (store014.store.pos_lines)
terms.description: A global trade item number uniquely identifying a specific product as scanned during checkout. Used to identify the product by its global standard identifier.

terms.name: Case Units
terms.description: The number of individual units (e.g., packs) that are contained in one case or pallet for inventory and logistics purposes.

terms.name: Case Weight In KG
terms.description: The total weight in kilograms of all products packed within a single case, used for shipping and storage calculations.

terms.name: Cost Price In INR
terms.description: The total cost incurred to acquire or produce one unit of the product in Indian Rupees, used for profit calculation.

terms.name: Distribution Center Slot
terms.description: The specific location within a distribution center where a product is stored or assigned for dispatch.

terms.name: Global Trade Item Number
terms.description: A global trade item number that uniquely identifies a specific product across supply chains and retail systems.

terms.name: Pack Unit
terms.description: The unit of measurement for the product's individual packaging, such as weight or volume, indicating how much is contained per pack.

terms.name: Product Flow
terms.description: The movement path of the product through the supply chain, either direct (DC) or distribution center to store (DSD).

terms.name: Product Name
terms.description: The full product name including type, ingredient, and size, as displayed to customers in the marketplace or store.

terms.name: Selling Price In INR
terms.description: The selling price of the product in Indian Rupees, as set by the retailer or seller for customer purchase.

terms.name: Shelf Audit
terms.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated or audited.

terms.name: Inventory Count
terms.description: The timestamp indicating when the inventory count was performed.

terms.name: Product SKU (store014.store.stock_counts)
terms.description: The unique identifier for a specific product item, such as a type of grain or spice, based on its category and size.

terms.name: Product Information
terms.description: A product-specific identifier that uniquely defines the type and size of an item, such as sugar or rice in specific weight categories.

terms.name: Purchase Order
terms.description: A unique identifier for each sales order, formatted as a string with a prefix indicating the order type and a numeric suffix.

terms.name: Write Off
terms.description: The date when the inventory item was written off.

terms.name: Confirmation Method
terms.description: The method or system used to confirm the availability of a product, specifically 'slot label scan'.

terms.name: Confirmed Case Quantity
terms.description: The number of cases that have been confirmed and matched to the actual inventory available in the warehouse.

terms.name: Order
terms.description: A unique identifier for a customer order, formatted as SO- followed by date and number.

terms.name: Order Case Quantity
terms.description: The total number of cases originally ordered for a specific SKU in an order line.

terms.name: Order Line
terms.description: The sequence number of the line item within an order, indicating its position in the order list.

terms.name: Pick Confirmation
terms.description: The date and time when an item was picked from the warehouse, indicating the actual fulfillment event for inventory retrieval.

terms.name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.pick_confirmations)
terms.description: A unique product identifier representing the type and size of a specific item, such as flour or sugar.

terms.name: Shipment
terms.description: A unique identifier for a shipment, formatted as SHP- followed by date and number.

terms.name: Warehouse Slot
terms.description: The warehouse storage location where the item is stored, identified by a letter and number combination.

terms.name: Case Quantity
terms.description: The total number of cases (standard containers) included in a shipment for a particular SKU.

terms.name: Container
terms.description: A 12-digit barcode identifier uniquely assigned to a specific physical container or pallet in the supply chain.

terms.name: Delivery Line
terms.description: The sequential position of an item within a shipment or order, indicating its order in the delivery list.

terms.name: Product GTIN
terms.description: A global trade item number uniquely identifying each specific product variant in the supply chain.

terms.name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
terms.description: The product-specific identifier representing the type and size of goods being shipped, such as 'ATT-A-WW-5KG' indicating a 5kg bag of atta.

terms.name: Sales Order
terms.description: A unique identifier for each sales order, formatted as 'SO' followed by a date and sequence number.

terms.name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
terms.description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with the prefix 'SHP' followed by a date and sequence number.

terms.name: Unit Quantity
terms.description: The total number of individual units (e.g., bags, packets) contained within the cases for each SKU.

terms.name: Adjustment Reason
terms.description: A textual explanation for why a variance or discrepancy exists in the recorded data, such as differences in slot counts or cycle counts. This provides context for the adjustment event.

terms.name: Adjustment Timestamp
terms.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last adjusted or updated in the system. This captures the point in time when a stock adjustment event occurred, serving as an audit trail for changes to inventory records.

terms.name: Cases Count
terms.description: The number of cases (standard packaging units) associated with the product in a given slot. This reflects the packaged quantity stored at a specific location.

terms.name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.stock_adjustments)
terms.description: A unique identifier for a specific product item, such as a type of produce or food item. This field identifies the product being adjusted in inventory.

terms.name: Storage Slot
terms.description: The storage location or bin slot where the product is stored within a warehouse or rack system. This identifies the physical inventory location associated with the stock adjustment.

terms.name: Units Count
terms.description: The total number of individual units (e.g., pieces or items) contained within the product, including negative values indicating missing units. This field represents actual physical inventory levels.

terms.name: Value At Cost In INR
terms.description: The total monetary value of the product at cost, expressed in Indian Rupees, with negative values indicating potential discrepancies or shortfalls. This reflects the financial impact of inventory variance.
